hold_text: Starts the live apply path automatically: on a push to main touching comms/live_review/reviews.jsonl it files one live-review-apply (apply: true) system-action per NEW row that passes live_review_dispatch.check_row. Every gate stays on the VM (dispatcher clauses + idempotency, apply_mode, granted mandate, approve_amend). Needs ONE operator OK before merge (LTR-APPLY-AUTOFLOW row: Tier 2).
why: new workflow + script + tests; no src/, config, order-path or VM file changed; it removes the manager hop between a landed tighten_sl row and the existing system-action
